purpose: Cassette tape concept assets for Taylor Bryant's Experience section
note: Company-inspired artwork based on current official websites; not official company assets or historical branding reproductions.

assets.name: Noto
assets.direction: Warm clear shell, cream paper, charcoal lettering, violet and indigo arcs, pale yellow dot.
assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE photorealistic cassette tape design for Taylor Bryant's personal website Experience section.
References: image 1 is an approved comparison board; use ONLY its upper cassette row as the physical design and craftsmanship reference, not its website layout or any CD cases. Image 2 is Noto's official website, for brand palette and simple wordmark reference only; ignore all webpage text, people, layout, and photographs.
Deliver a single isolated compact audio cassette, outside its case, on a genuinely transparent alpha background. Landscape image, tape centered and occupying about 88% of image width with generous clean transparent margins. Almost perfectly front-on orthographic view, level, no in-plane tilt, extremely subtle visible top/right thickness. Consistent realistic 1.6:1 cassette silhouette. Two ivory six-toothed hubs visible through a smoked transparent window, dark brown magnetic tape, five tiny silver screws, clear beveled shell edges and restrained fine surface wear. No floor or cast shadow; preserve realistic shading and reflections ON the object. High-end product photograph, not cartoon.
Specific design: Noto. Translucent warm pearl / clear polycarbonate shell. Cream paper label with charcoal print. Broad softly printed muted violet and indigo concentric arcs along the lower label, inspired by the calming violet light on Noto's site. One tiny pale lemon-yellow accent dot. The company name is prominent, clean simple lettering exactly "Noto." in the upper left, with the dot pale lemon yellow. Handwritten dates "2020–now" in charcoal on the upper right or lower right. Small print "SIDE A" on the left. Optional single small "01" catalog number. Do not include job title, slogan, extra names, website text, or facts. Readable at thumbnail size.
The tape should feel personal, tactile, quietly optimistic, and lightly handled, not heavily scratched or dirty. Keep the label large enough for company and dates and leave the reels unobstructed. No cassette player, case, props, other tapes, checkerboard pattern, background, watermark, or borders. Output a usable individual PNG cutout, not a comparison board.

assets.name: Livestock Nutrition Center
assets.direction: Forest green shell, cream label, wheat tones and pastoral illustration.
assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup / precise-object-edit. Create one individual cassette tape asset for a personal website's work history.
Reference image 1 is the approved Noto cassette. Preserve its exact front-facing camera, overall proportions, framing, size, ivory toothed hubs, reel-window geometry, five screws, lightly handled realistic plastic and paper textures. Change ONLY the shell tint and printed paper label to the company specified below. The tape must fill the same amount of the landscape frame with transparent margins on all sides, no clipping. Genuinely transparent alpha background, clean smooth silhouette without specks, halos, scraps, or background residue. No cast/floor shadow. Keep realistic object shading and reflections. Output a single isolated cassette, not a scene, not a website. No other objects, cases, hands, watermarks, or checkerboard. Text must be exact and readable. Reference image 2 is Livestock Nutrition Center's official website; use its forest green and wheat-tan palette and agricultural subject matter, ignore its navigation and paragraphs. Design a lightly translucent smoky forest-green shell, warm cream paper label, bold dark-green "LNC" at upper left and smaller "Livestock Nutrition Center" directly below, handwritten dates "2018–2020" toward upper right, small "SIDE A" at left. Use forest green, wheat tan, ivory, and dark ink. Warm, practical, quietly rustic; no cartoon farm animals, no grunge overload.

assets.name: Self-employed
assets.direction: Smoky amber shell, warm ivory label, burnt-orange and ochre stripes, charcoal felt-tip handwriting on masking tape.
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / product-mockup.
Asset type: one photorealistic compact cassette cutout for a personal website's Experience section.
Primary request: redesign the Self-employed cassette with much stronger art direction, like a cherished homemade demo from an independent musician who also built websites.
Input image 1: edit target, the current Self-employed tape. Preserve the exact front-on orthographic camera, compact cassette silhouette, scale within frame, hub centers, two ivory six-toothed hubs, five screws, dark brown magnetic tape and realistic mechanical construction. Completely redesign its shell color and paper label.
Input image 2: supporting reference for the other tapes' tactile realism and craftsmanship only. Do not copy the Noto name or purple artwork.
Art direction: rich translucent smoky amber / warm honey-brown polycarbonate with subtly visible internal ribs, chrome screw heads, warm ivory hubs. The label is warm uncoated ivory paper with a beautiful vintage blank-cassette graphic: a broad burnt-orange band and a narrower golden-ochre band flowing horizontally beneath the reel window, with rounded corners at the ends, restrained dark charcoal details. Strong warm color at thumbnail size. A strip of cream matte masking tape across the upper label carries the title, almost straight with very slightly uneven torn SHORT ends confined inside the cassette label. Real tape-on-paper material detail, not a loose scrap.
Text exactly: "Self-employed" in prominent charcoal felt-tip hand lettering, bold and compact and readable, natural mixed case, confident informal strokes rather than cursive calligraphy. "2011–2017" in smaller neat black handwriting at the lower right on a clean cream patch. Small printed "SIDE A" on the left.
Composition: the cassette fills approximately 91% of the image width, centered in a landscape 1.6:1 image with transparent margins all around, complete object visible, same alignment as the edit target. Label layout leaves the reels and window unobstructed.
Mood and materials: understated indie demo tape, authentic used physical object, a little handling wear, warm analog nostalgia; purposeful graphic design, not messy or heavily distressed.
Keep realistic lighting/reflections/shading ON the object. Genuinely transparent alpha background and clean silhouette. No floor or cast shadows. No blue ink, notebook ruling, pixel art, code symbols, computer imagery, company logos, invented clients, extra wording, cassette case, props, hands, other tapes, watermark, checkerboard, backdrop or website layout. Deliver a single isolated finished asset.
